activity_summary: You kept morning prayer at the inn's long table. You named the night as the old play, once, a year to the day, and you refused to improve Egeon. Kemp started the Greenwich dog and Bryan stopped him with the old sentence. Phillips kept Nick under the note. No jig has been left yet. Heminges has no purse and no sum, and the two cloaks are still waiting on a yeoman and a light.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the year and the one night, and refused to improve the tale.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Kept prayer in its place, and stopped the dog.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Started the dog, and then held it.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Took the old play once, and would not help the laugh.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept Nick under the note, and kept the morning from becoming a chorus.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Told you to give the tale and come off.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused a receipt, and kept the cloaks for a real count.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: In the room, under the note, and not singing.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Named as carrying what he is given, and not searching.

entities.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon
entities.context: Not in the room. His content has not arrived.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Morning prayer at the inn

facets.activity: Kept morning prayer at the table and named the old play once

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A year to the day. Tonight is the old play, once.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: She heard the dog at Greenwich. One does not tell her Majesty the same dog twice.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Happiness is still not a licence.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: If my lord is content he will send a man. He has not sent one.
